event.Description: DIN event code marking stimulus intensity (DIN6-DI10)

intensity_db.Description: Tone intensity in decibels corresponding to the event label

n1_window_start.Description: Start of the N1 search window, derived from the subject grand average (pooled across intensities and channels)

n1_window_end.Description: End of the N1 search window

p2_window_start.Description: Start of the P2 search window, derived from the subject grand average

p2_window_end.Description: End of the P2 search window

n1_latency.Description: Latency of the minimum voltage within the N1 window, for this channel and intensity

n1_amplitude.Description: Minimum voltage within the N1 window, for this channel and intensity

p2_latency.Description: Latency of the maximum voltage within the P2 window, for this channel and intensity

p2_amplitude.Description: Maximum voltage within the P2 window, for this channel and intensity

slope_between_points_uV_per_s.Description: Rate of amplitude change between the N1 point and the P2 point, computed independently per intensity: (P2 amplitude - N1 amplitude) / (P2 latency - N1 latency)

lin_offset_uV.Description: Intercept of the linear regression of N1-P2 peak-to-peak amplitude against stimulus intensity (dB), fit per channel across all intensities

lin_slope_uV_per_dB.Description: Slope of the linear regression of N1-P2 peak-to-peak amplitude against stimulus intensity (dB), fit per channel across all intensities. This is the classic loudness-dependence-of-the-auditory-evoked-potential (LDAEP) measure.

lin_rmse_uV.Description: Root mean square error of the linear regression fit described above, per channel
